card.name: Suicidal thinking or behavior wording
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "or" or "and" right after suicidal thinking, thoughts or ideation, and the word suicide or attempted just before "attempt" or "suicide". It is mainly in adverse-event and risk-warning text.

modes.label: Linking word after suicidal thinking
modes.description: "or" joins suicidal thinking, thoughts or ideation to behavior or attempt.
modes.example: twice the risk (adjusted Relative Risk 1.8, 95% CI:1.2, 2.7) of suicidal thinking<< or>> behavior compared to patients randomized to placebo.

modes.label: Suicide or attempted before the next term
modes.description: The word suicide or attempted itself, in lists of suicide attempt and completed suicide.
modes.example: Suicidal ideation and<< suicide>> attempt were reported in 1 participant.

card.writes: It boosts suicide-related words such as suicide, attempt, suicides and killing.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say suicide or suicide attempt, for example in the warning that lists suicidal thoughts or behavior.
